definitions.explanation: The act of selecting or calling on a specific person by name for a role, task, or action.

examples.japanese: ⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{指名|しめい}⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I was called on by the teacher.

examples.japanese: ⟦{監督|かんとく}→監督：00185_kantoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{次|つぎ}→次：00819_tsugi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦キャプテン→キャプテン：00258_kyaputen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{指名|しめい}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The coach designated the next captain.

examples.japanese: {指名|しめい}⟦{手配|てはい}→手配：07604_tehai⟧⟦されていた→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{容疑者|ようぎしゃ}→容疑者：15039_yougisha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ようやく⟦{逮捕|たいほ}→逮捕：03397_taiho⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The suspect who had been placed on the wanted list was finally arrested.

notes:
USAGE:
Used when someone is specifically selected by name, whether in a classroom, at work, or in official contexts. In baseball, {指名|しめい}⟦{打者|だしゃ}→打者：06564_dasha⟧ means "designated hitter." In law enforcement, {指名|しめい}⟦{手配|てはい}→手配：07604_tehai⟧ means to put someone on a wanted list.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {指名|しめい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to nominate, to designate
- {指名|しめい}⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧: to be called on, to be nominated
- {指名|しめい}⟦{手配|てはい}→手配：07604_tehai⟧: wanted (by police)
- {指名|しめい}⟦{打者|だしゃ}→打者：06564_dasha⟧: designated hitter (baseball)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{任命|にんめい}→任命：09764_ninmei⟧: appointment (to an official position, more formal)
- ⟦{氏名|しめい}→氏名：04033_shimei⟧: full name (same reading, different meaning and kanji)
